newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Nine giraffes killed in S.African road crash.
newsitem.headline: Nine giraffes killed in S.African road crash.

text.p: Nine giraffes died in a highway crash in South Africa on Wednesday, police said.
The group was being ferried at dawn to a game reserve near Pretoria when the driver of their truck swerved to avoid a minibus taxi which had overtaken him and then slowed down.
The truck left the road and overturned.
Six of the animals died immediately and animal welfare officials had to kill three others with severe neck injuries, police spokesman Morne van Wyk said.
The truck driver and two passengers were unhurt, as was one of the giraffes.
